description: Defines a template class 'Sensors' implementing Android hardware sensors interface, managing sensor activation, event handling, wake lock management, and communication with sensor hardware via message queues and event flags.

classes.name: Sensors
classes.description: Template class implementing Android sensor HAL, managing sensors, event queues, wake locks, and callbacks.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the operation mode for all sensors.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor by handle.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes sensor event and wake lock message queues, and callback.

methods.name: initializeBase
methods.description: Performs core initialization, including disabling sensors, setting up event queues, and starting wake lock thread.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Sets batch parameters for a sensor.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor data for a given sensor handle.

methods.name: injectSensorData
methods.description: Injects sensor event data into the sensor pipeline.

methods.name: postEvents
methods.description: Posts sensor events to the event queue and manages wake lock if needed.

methods.name: AddSensor
methods.description: Template method to add a new sensor instance.

methods.name: deleteEventFlag
methods.description: Deletes the event flag used for signaling.

methods.name: startReadWakeLockThread
methods.description: Starts the thread to read wake lock message queue.

methods.name: readWakeLockFMQ
methods.description: Reads wake lock message queue and updates wake lock state.

methods.name: updateWakeLock
methods.description: Manages acquiring and releasing wake lock based on wake-up events.
